parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a wooden panel attached to the front of the cabinet, typically hinged on one side.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet and can be opened or closed using a handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a rectangular wooden compartment located above the cabinet door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a sliding storage space for smaller items, typically accessed by pulling the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the cabinet, supporting the door, drawer, and base.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity and defines the overall shape and compartments of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports other moving parts.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform that supports the entire structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and elevates the cabinet slightly above the floor to prevent moisture damage.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
